items.title: Dick Katz interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: there was some musicians who almost craved anonymity, gifted, like Davey Schildkraut. You ever heard of him?

ctx.x: So you can’t just blame it on the music in other words.
No. Because I have a feeling, no. And then there were other people, there was some musicians who almost craved anonymity, gifted, like Davey Schildkraut. You ever heard of him?
